published_motif_sanity.conclusion: Reducing L alone cannot represent the published guide-target interaction; consecutive index-wise identity is the wrong contact model.
published_motif_sanity.structural_constraint: The published system uses subterminal hairpins and ordered canonical/noncanonical contacts; these fourmers are not asserted to be a simple uninterrupted reverse-complement duplex.
